items.quote: Following thermal analysis, the product phase selection was determined by X-ray diffraction and the solidification microstructure was examined by scanning electron microscopy, SEM, study of the exterior droplet surface and interior droplet sections.

Following thermal analysis, the product phase selection was determined by X-ray diffraction and the solidification microstructure was examined by scanning electron microscopy, SEM, study of the exterior droplet surface and interior droplet sections.

The application of back-scattered electron imaging on the unetched droplet sections established that the central core region was a Cd-rich phase (dark) which was surrounded by a Pb-rich phase (light) region.
Other evidence based upon in situ X-ray diffraction measurements has confirmed that no solid phases develop during these thermal events.
